notes: Every Item from 1 to 15 has one body heading; the contents list at lines 47 to 74 gives Item numbers without the word 'Item' and is not labeled. Item 8 prints the full financial statements and supplementary data. Items 1B, 4, 9 and 9B say only 'None.', which is an answer, so they are not marked (the labelers differed here). Items 11 to 14 only refer to the proxy statement. Hard call (the labelers differed): Item 10 refers to the proxy statement and adds a code of ethics paragraph of its own (whom the code covers, where it is posted, how amendments and waivers are disclosed), so it is not marked, as with O'Reilly 2005 in this set and Funko 2026 in bench/fresh2; the Apple 2016, Visa 2017, BTCS 2025 and MSB Financial labels mark such an Item. Item 15 lists the exhibits itself and ends at SIGNATURES. Schedule II (valuation and qualifying accounts) and the exhibit index follow the signatures and belong to no Item.
